items.title: Dogecoin Gets a Dedicated Company to Build Out Its Ecosystem
items.summary: Formed with the Dogecoin Foundation and led by MyDoge founder Jordan Jefferson, the new company consolidates the MyDoge wallet, DogeOS app platform, and Such App to build an economy around DOGE.

items.title: Dogecoin wallet, app teams unite in push to give DOGE more everyday uses
items.summary: Dogecoin Labs will combine MyDoge, DogeOS and merchant payment tools as developers try to turn coin holders into customers for applications and businesses.

items.title: Switzerland approves first spot Bitcoin ETF for retail investors
items.summary: BIT Asset Management’s Bitcoin Fund ETF is expected to begin trading on SIX Swiss Exchange in November, with its public offering restricted to Switzerland.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Erase October Losses With $1 Billion in Three Days
items.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs have drawn about $1.07 billion over three sessions, pushing October flows to a gain of roughly $460 million, even as Bitcoin and Ethereum prices slipped.

items.title: Bitcoin circles $81.5K ETF cost basis as Trump Iran comments send stocks lower
items.summary: Bitcoin extended daily losses to 3% as US stocks came under pressure from President Donald Trump’s comments on Iran military action.

items.title: Thailand SEC says several companies eye crypto ETFs, none has applied
items.summary: Thailand’s SEC says several asset managers have sought consultations on spot crypto ETFs, but it cannot confirm whether the first funds will launch in 2026.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF buyers are trend followers, not setters, DWF Labs says
items.summary: DWF Labs research finds that Bitcoin ETF flows follow past BTC price movements rather than predict future returns, with investors buying rallies and selling dips.

items.title: Crypto traders seek shelter in bitcoin as altcoins slide and ETF flows wobble
Live updates: Bitcoin falls back to $81,000, with interest rates tumbling as stocks crack
items.summary: The Nasdaq is down more than 2% as the AI bull market trade continues to unwind. U.S. interest rates are plunging even as oil surges.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs bag another $528M, taking 3-day haul past $1B
